asset.name: Hedera

score_rationales.supply: HBAR has a hard-capped 50B max supply pre-minted at genesis; Hedera’s Treasury Management Report (data through Apr 2026) states all 50B is allocated with 0 unallocated supply, and circulation grows via scheduled allocation releases rather than unlimited inflation. Third-party trackers (e.g. Glassnode circulating-supply series, CoinGlass) place circulating supply near ~43.3B HBAR (~86–87% of max), which is bullish float but still implies ongoing unlock cadence from treasury buckets. Messari State of Hedera Q1 2025 cited ~15.9B HBAR staked (~37.7% of circulating), supporting reduced liquid supply for consensus, though Hedera’s FAQ emphasizes staking stays liquid with no lock-up; exchange-balance trends were not verified here for a directional reserves call.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: Hedera is processing on the order of hundreds of thousands of mainnet transactions per day with Crypto/transfer-weighted mix (~68% Crypto Service in reported quarterly breakdowns) and a fast-growing on-network stablecoin footprint near ~$70M+, indicating real payment-token activity; scale still trails dominant settlement/L2 rails and there is no ODL-style public corridor volume comparable to XRP for this category.
score_rationales.value_capture: Fees minimal by design. Value capture excluded for this asset.
